inputs.name: audioFileUrl
inputs.label: Audio File URL
inputs.placeholder: https://... or {{nodeId.fileUrl}} from an upstream node

inputs.name: language
inputs.label: Language (optional)
inputs.placeholder: en, zh, ms, fr… leave blank for auto-detect

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.label: Context Hint (optional)
inputs.placeholder: Provide context to improve accuracy, e.g. technical terms, names, abbreviations.

outputs.name: transcript
outputs.label: Transcript
outputs.description: The full text transcription of the audio.

outputs.name: language
outputs.label: Detected Language
outputs.description: ISO 639-1 language code detected in the audio.

outputs.name: duration
outputs.label: Duration (seconds)
outputs.description: Total duration of the audio file in seconds.
